This '''individual''' was a [[Bith]] who owned a bakery in [[Ackbar City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, saw the Bith pleading with a [[Unidentified female Pop-Dog|female]] [[Pop-Dogs|Pop-Dog]], a Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] unit stationed on the planet, in front of his condemned bakery.<ref name="MK" />
